First, understand the context: This is likely for the Fabric SDK or configtxlator/ config API? The specification mentions "Fabric channel configuration API" and functions to retrieve org config, update policies, add orgs, retrieve MSP config, revoke cert. These are likely Go or Node.js API functions in Fabric's config update library. We need to assume we are developing in Go (since Fabric core is Go) but could be other. We'll assume Go.

We'll break down into activities: Understanding existing codebase, designing APIs, implementing each user story (some overlap), writing unit tests, updating example tests, documentation? Specification says "example tests should also be updated to demonstrate usage" so we need to update example tests. Also acceptance criteria mention "call a function" so we need to implement functions.

We'll group similar stories to avoid duplication. U1 and U7 are retrieval functions. U2, U3, U4 are updating policies for different org types. U5, U6 are adding orgs. U8 is revoking cert.

We'll also need to consider integration, code review, testing. Since developer is doing all work, we include activities for each.

2. Implement retrieval of org configuration (U1): function to get application/orderer/consortium org config as Organization.
3. Implement retrieval of MSP configuration (U7): function to get MSP config for a specific org.
4. Implement update application org policies (U2): function to add/remove policies on application org and group.
5. Implement update orderer org policies (U3): similar for orderer.
6. Implement update consortium org policies (U4): similar for consortium.

10. Update example tests for each user story (U1-U8): modify existing example test files to demonstrate usage.
11. Write unit tests for new functions.
12. Integration testing and debugging.

Retrieval functions (U1, U7) will parse the config transaction's config group tree to extract the appropriate organization or MSP configuration.
Policy update functions (U2, U3, U4) will reuse existing add/remove policy logic on config groups, targeting application, orderer, and consortium groups.

Example tests will be updated in existing test files to demonstrate usage of each new function.

activities.activity_description: Analyze user stories, review existing codebase (config update API, group manipulation), design function signatures and integration points.
Implement function to retrieve application, orderer, or consortium org configuration from a config transaction, returning an Organization struct.
Implement function to retrieve MSP configuration for a specific organization from a config transaction, returning FabricMSPConfig.

activities.activity_name: Implement U2 – Update Application Org Policies

activities.activity_name: Implement U3 – Update Orderer Org Policies
activities.activity_description: Implement function to add or remove policies on an orderer org and orderer group within a config transaction.

activities.activity_name: Implement U4 – Update Consortium Org Policies
activities.activity_description: Implement function to add or remove policies on a consortium org, consortiums group, and consortium group within a config transaction.
Implement function to create a channel config transaction containing a new orderer org definition.
Implement function to create a channel config transaction containing a new application org definition.
Implement function to revoke a certificate by verifying it was issued by the org's MSP and modifying the revocation_list field; return error if certificate not issued by MSP.
Update existing example test files to demonstrate usage of all new functions (U1 through U8) as per acceptance criteria.
Write comprehensive unit tests covering all new functions, including normal cases, edge cases, and error paths.
Run full test suite (unit and example tests), debug integration issues, fix any defects discovered.
Perform self-review, add inline comments, update package documentation and any relevant README files.
